[[File:Havla.png|thumb|right|250px|Exo-protein wafers]]
'''Exo-protein wafers''' were an enhanced type of protein wafers used by [[Spacer/Legends|space farers]] on long trips. They consisted of a [[protein]] source that was usually [[:Category:Meat|meat]], and a preservative wrap made of animal hide.
